title: Zero Field Genesis: A Proposed Spectral Framework Connecting Riemann Zeta Zeros, Light, and Dark Energy
content: This work proposes Zero Field Genesis (ZFG) as a new spectral framework for the origin of Riemann zeta zeros. Building on the Zero Pairs Interaction Functional (ZPIF), Unified Spectral Alignment and Coherence (USAC), Zigzag Zero–Fractional Zero (ZZFZ), the Lunet Hypothesis, and the Rippling Theory, we suggest that the non-trivial zeros emerge from a deeper spectral field—the Zero Field—through a generative process governed by spectral coherence and fractional dynamics. We explore dark energy as high spectral coherence and black holes as low spectral coherence. The Lunet resolves wave-particle duality through coherence-dependent manifestation. We introduce the Zero Field Genesis Equation as a tentative description of zero generation. This framework opens potential directions in solar energy, ultra-precision medicine, quantum computing, and space propulsion. This is a theoretical proposal intended to stimulate discussion and further investigation.
